title: Problem Abstraction
description: Upstream cross-domain artifact. Output of mathematical-formalizer. Turns a concrete research problem into a TYPED mechanism abstraction plus a formal problem class. domain_surface holds the original field-specific phrasing; mechanism_primitives are domain-NEUTRAL primitives (field-agnostic — no medical/NLP/RL nouns) that name the underlying mechanisms; formal_form names the mathematical class the problem belongs to (graph / manifold / variational / dynamical / statistical / optimization / none), determined deterministically by formal_problem_schema.classify_form from the primitive set. This artifact abstracts; it asserts NO novelty, feasibility, or solution — those are downstream judgments. abstraction_confidence is advisory only (a self-reported confidence in the abstraction, never a gate). Anti-slop: every present string field is non-blank (pattern \S).

problem_id.description: Short unique identifier for this abstraction, e.g. PA-001. Non-blank.

domain_surface.description: The original, domain-specific phrasing of the problem (the surface form before abstraction), e.g. 'segment the inferior alveolar canal in CBCT scans'. Non-blank.

mechanism_primitives.description: Domain-NEUTRAL mechanism primitives underlying the problem (field-agnostic — never a domain noun). MAY be empty: a problem whose mechanism could not be reduced to any known primitive is legitimately empty, and formal_form is then 'none'. Each present item is one of the closed primitive vocabulary.

failure_modes.description: The ways this problem class is known to fail / be hard (mechanism-level, domain-neutral phrasing preferred). MAY be empty. Each present item is a non-blank string.

constraints.description: Hard constraints the problem imposes (e.g. label scarcity, compute ceiling, real-time budget). MAY be empty. Each present item is a non-blank string.

success_metrics.description: How success is measured at the mechanism level (e.g. boundary fidelity, connectivity preservation, calibration). MAY be empty. Each present item is a non-blank string.

formal_form.description: The mathematical problem class. Determined deterministically by formal_problem_schema.classify_form from mechanism_primitives via a documented priority rule table. 'none' when no primitive maps to a form (including an empty primitive set).

abstraction_confidence.description: Self-reported confidence in [0, 1] that this abstraction faithfully captures the problem's mechanism. ADVISORY ONLY — never a gate or cut. Low confidence is legitimate and must stay representable.

notes.description: Optional clarifying notes (e.g. why a primitive was or was not assigned, drift against the north star).
